headline: Paid More
caption:
UPDATE: Michael 'Venom' Page says his Misfits deal pays more than his entire UFC run 💰
UFC or Misfits? 👇

MVP told Ariel Helwani it's a three-fight, 18-month deal paying seven figures per fight, and said the UFC puts entertainment ahead of merit. No opponent is set yet. MMA news.

Who should he fight first?
question: UFC or Misfits?

v2.story: Page says three Misfits fights pay more than his whole UFC career.
